articles.title: Bitcoin’s quantum problem gets a recovery tool, but not for Satoshi’s 1.1 million coins
articles.snippet: Project Eleven says it has funded a proof that lets a wallet's own key-derivation path stand in as ownership after quantum computers can forge its signatures. It runs in 243 milliseconds on a laptop.

articles.title: Stripe and Swift race to control the next generation of global payments infrastructure
articles.snippet: Crypto and blockchain experts say this week's moves show the two established finance companies are increasingly competing for control of the infrastructure behind digital payments.

articles.title: Cardano hands core development to outside teams in decentralization push
articles.snippet: Input Output will transfer control of the Haskell node, Plutus, Hydra and other components as founder Charles Hoskinson says the network must change and start growing again.

articles.title: Inside Robinhood’s high-stakes bet to onboard millions of casual users onto decentralized finance
articles.snippet: The company says its advantage lies in bringing retail customers onchain, but early activity remains dominated by memecoins, while its original tokenization vision remains small.

articles.title: Kaspersky identifies malware framework targeting crypto investors
articles.snippet: Cybersecurity company Kaspersky said a newly identified malware framework is targeting cryptocurrency investors through social engineering tactics and trojanized GitHub apps.
